Card #37231. Dev report: 7163984482.

- **Fix:**
  - `useRowApprovalLocks` keeps the batch lock door's `lockSource` on a `locked: true` entry and exposes `heldByMaster(recordId)`. It is true only for a row a read answered `lockSource: 'master'`.
  - The grid's row CRUD verdict (`objectGridActionsColumn.tsx`) ANDs `!heldByMaster` into `canDelete`. The row menu, the context menu and the list-page selection bar all read `rowActionMenuProps`, so all three drop Delete on a master-held line.
  - A record-held row keeps Delete and loses Edit, as before. A 501, a `null` entry, or a failed or unasked read leaves the menu unchanged.
  - The column docblock and the hook comment are updated.
- **Declared widening,** in Acceptance notes: `ObjectGrid.tsx` now also enables the lock read on a grid whose rows offer Delete but no Edit (`rowMenuReadsLocks`). Without it, a Delete-only grid never reads the lock. This is inside the claimed file. It has no separate ablation; pin (2) below covers it.
- **Pins,** in the top-level describe `objectstack#37231` in `rowMenuApprovalLock-36911.test.tsx`:
  1. A master-held row offers neither Edit nor Delete. The record-held sibling keeps Delete, and the open sibling offers both.
  2. A Delete-only grid drops Delete on the master-held line.
  3. The list-page selection bar does the same, with one lock read in total.

  The 501, `null` and failed-read controls now include a master-held row, and stay green.
- **Ablation:** deleting ` && !heldByMasterAnswered(row)` turns all three master pins red (3 failed, 7 passed). Restored to blob == HEAD. Two earlier attempts collected no tests (one was a refused no-op, one a syntax break) and are not counted.

  - harness 10 of 10;
  - plugin-grid 313 files and 2786 tests;
  - type-check exit 0;
  - 39 of 39 dispatch-gates families exit 0.

  Overlap-check is clean; #37215 shares two files but merges cleanly.
- **Size:** +148 −28 across 5 files, not governed.
- **Check-runs at this head:** 40 success, 13 skipped, 0 failing or pending.
- **K:** 9.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · L1 · head `929d5f0d6865c50aa8c0715d2028b8f369638a20` · 2026-11-25T14:27Z

Card #37231 (p2, size S). Checked against GitHub and a local run at the head, not against the dev report. Merge base `4ed453dc211f`, net diff +148 −28 across 5 files. All 5 files are inside the claim's file surface. Not a governed surface, and none of the four contract faces is touched, so no L2 is owed.

**Checklist**
- PR shape: draft, base `main`, body line 1 `Fixes #37231`. The card is open and carries no `needs-user-decision`. A closing-keyword scan of the full body finds only that one hit. The body has no `content/docs/releases/` or `skills/**` change, so no `Skills-docs:` line is owed (kind `none`, no arm).
- Fix matches the card. `useRowApprovalLocks` keeps `lockSource` only on a `locked: true` entry, and only for `'record'` or `'master'`. `heldByMaster` is true only for an answered `'master'`. `rowCrudVerdicts` ANDs `!heldByMasterAnswered(row)` into `canDelete`, and Edit keeps its `isLocked` gate. The row menu, the context menu and the list-page selection bar all read `rowActionMenuProps`, so each one follows. A 501, a `null` entry, or a failed or unasked read leaves `heldByMaster` false. The server side agrees: `recordLockAnswer` returns `master` first (`approval-service.ts:2256`), and `bindDetailRowLockHook` throws `code = 'RECORD_LOCKED'`.
- Declared extension: `rowMenuReadsLocks = (canEdit && !!onEdit) || (canDelete && !!onDelete)` replaces `rowMenuOffersEdit` in the hook enable and in `demandRowActions`. This is right, and the card's reach needs it. `RelatedList` wires `onEdit` only when `onRowEdit` is set (`RelatedList.tsx:3981-3982`), so without the extension a related list over lines that offers Delete but no Edit would never read the lock. Nothing else changes behaviour. `describeCell` and `onCellSelect` still gate on `hostCellSelection` and read only the boolean. The hook fetches only from `probe`, never on mount. The comment and docblock edits make the comments true, and `git grep` at the head finds no remaining "keeps Edit and Delete" or `#37041` claim in plugin-grid.
- `Clause-②: no` is correct. `ApprovalLockSource` (new export) and `RowApprovalLocks.heldByMaster` (new member) live in `hooks/useRowApprovalLocks.ts`, and `index.tsx` does not re-export that file. I built `@object-ui/plugin-grid` at the head and walked the `.d.ts` import graph from `dist/index.d.ts`: 29 files are reachable, and none names `RowApprovalLocks`, `heldByMaster`, `ApprovalLockSource`, `useRowApprovalLocks` or `objectGridActionsColumn`. The positive control `RowActionMenuProps` appears in `index.d.ts`. The only `.d.ts` carrying the new names is `dist/hooks/useRowApprovalLocks.d.ts`. That file is shipped bytes, but `exports` maps only `.` and `./style.css`, so it is not addressable and not public surface.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` is correct: nothing a metadata author can write changes. The changeset is a single `'@object-ui/plugin-grid': patch` (`private` unset, so the package is published). Kind `none` takes `patch`. Both declaration lines open the changeset body.
- Changeset sentences, checked one by one against the diff: the door path `POST /api/v1/approvals/records/:object/locks` matches `useRowApprovalLocks.ts`. "A row answered `lockSource: 'master'` offers neither Edit nor Delete", "a row answered `'record'` … keeps Delete", the selection-bar sentence, and the 501, `null`, failed and unasked sentence each match the code and a pin. "A grid whose rows offer Delete but no Edit now also reads the locks … still never sent on first paint" matches the code: the only caller of `probe` on this path is `demandRowActions`.
- 维护者速读, checked line by line against the diff. Line 1 「主单正在审批中的明细行…行菜单和选中栏不再出现「删除」;自身在审批中的记录仍可删除」 matches the verdict and pins (1) and (3). Line 2 「服务端早已拒绝这种删除,界面现在提前不提供」 matches the server's `RECORD_LOCKED` refusal. Line 3 「只影响按钮显示,不写数据,可直接撤回」 holds: the diff touches only the menu verdict and a read-only `POST` lock query. Line 4 「无」. The section has no code names, paths or bare card numbers.

**Spot readings (local, throwaway worktree, closure built with `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/plugin-grid^...' build`)**
- Head `929d5f0d`, harness `rowMenuApprovalLock-36911.test.tsx`: Test Files 1 passed, Tests 10 passed. This includes the three `objectstack#37231` pins.
- Ablation A: deleting ` && !heldByMasterAnswered(row)` gives the mutated blob `2fcebc3668cf`, the same blob the dev reported. Result: 3 failed | 7 passed, and all three failures are the `#37231` pins.
- Ablation B, which the dev did not run: reverting `rowMenuReadsLocks` to `canEdit && !!onEdit` gives 1 failed | 9 passed. The one failure is exactly pin (2), "a grid whose rows offer Delete but no Edit …". The extension is pinned independently.
- Ablation C: making the hook drop `lockSource` gives 3 failed | 7 passed, again the three `#37231` pins.
- After each ablation, the blobs were restored and re-hashed: `d9d2a5403f50` / `5049f60b2c57` / `ac42fcb38810`, each equal to `HEAD:<path>`.
- Merge probe (the `merge-tree` result committed locally over `origin/main` `08bf7d2a41a7`, closure rebuilt):
  - plugin-grid suite: Test Files 314 passed, Tests 2787 passed.
  - plugin-detail `RelatedList*` (59 files): Test Files 59 passed, Tests 387 passed. This covers the consumer that renders a grid with Delete but no Edit.
- Check-runs at `929d5f0d` (53 in total): 40 success, 13 skipped, 0 failure, 0 pending. Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Type Check UI, Lint UI and Check Changeset are each `success`. The Test UI rollup and its 11 planned shards (`Plan Test UI shards`: mode=affected, 3953 of 7181 files) are success. Build & E2E UI and Live E2E UI are success. The skips are path-selected or opt-in legs (Build Core, Test Core shards, Dogfood matrix, Packed-tarball smoke, among others).
- `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 929d5f0d` exits 0 with tree `dadb00773557`, so there is no conflict. Since the merge base, `origin/main` has advanced 10 commits. #37215 (`ask_ai`) touches `ObjectGrid.tsx` and `objectGridActionsColumn.tsx` in disjoint hunks, and the merge-probe suite above covers that pairing.
- Overlaps: #37283 (11 files) and #37293 (3 files) share no file with this PR. Neither diff touches `onEdit`, `onDelete` or the grid wiring in `RelatedList.tsx`, so there is no semantic overlap.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- N1 — In a related list on the master's own record page, every line is master-held. In a grid that offers Delete but no Edit there, the first reach for a row's ⋮ shows Delete while the read is on the wire. Once the read answers, each row offers nothing, so the Actions column stops drawing (`drawActionsColumn` reads `data.some(rowOffersAction)`). This is the same fail-open shape #36911 ships for Edit, so it is consistent with the design. It is recorded so that a reader of the showcase expense lines is not surprised.
- N2 — Pin (2) does not assert zero lock reads before the demand in a grid that offers Delete but no Edit. The `#36911` test "reads no lock before a row's actions are reached for" pins that only for a grid that offers Edit. The code path is shared (`demandRowActions` is the only `probe` caller off the cell path), so this costs no confidence today.
- N3 — `ApprovalLockSource` restates the client's inline `'record' | 'master'` union (`packages/client/src/index.ts:7182`). The hook reads the door through raw `apiFetch` rather than the client, so there is no shared type to import. This is a note only.

- Landing: the zone lands it. K is 10, below 15, so no merge of main is needed first. Before arming it, check that Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check read `success` at the head being queued.
